unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Finding your own combination
drDigitalIntro:
None of these settings is the right answer on its own. The right answer is the mixture that suits you.
• Someone reading at night might want Warm colors, high contrast and no inverting.
• Someone with glare-sensitive eyes might want inverting and nothing else.
• Change one thing at a time and look at the screen after each one. Changing three at once tells you nothing.
• In this activity you will build one such combination: a warm, high-contrast screen with heavier text.

playgroundTask.goal: You built a warm, high-contrast, bold-text screen

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.

drDigitalSuccess: That is one combination out of dozens. Yours might look nothing like it, and that is the point.
drDigitalHint: Work down the Accessibility page: Bold Text is in the first card, the other two are in the Color and Contrast card.
